data.one_liner: Design custom Flutter pages and turn them into high-quality PDF documents.
data.what_it_does: PDF Maker is a Flutter plugin that allows developers to design custom pages using standard widgets and convert them into high-quality, single-page or multi-page PDF documents. It provides real-time previews, multi-language support, and isolated rendering options for performance optimization.
use_when: You need to generate PDF documents from custom widget layouts in Flutter.
You want to support multi-page PDF documents with customizable formats, margins, and scales.
You require background isolate rendering to keep the UI thread responsive during PDF generation.
avoid_when: You need complex low-level programmatic PDF drawing operations outside of Flutter's widget tree.
strengths: Design freedom using regular Flutter widgets via BlankPage subclasses.
Supports both single-page and multi-page PDF document generation.
Isolated rendering mode to prevent freezing the main UI thread during heavy PDF generation.
weaknesses: Requires proper management of BuildContext to access theme data and contextual properties.
data.setup_notes: Add pdf_maker to your pubspec.yaml dependencies.
